name: cloud-dense-context-10m-v0
scope: Exploratory 9,998,336-token dense from-scratch control, same seed and article set as separate 1M pilot; repeated corpus epochs, not independent replication. Pure GPTNeoX, not Qwen hybrid. Launched only if the frozen 1M context gate fails.
rationale: Failed uniform-probe and sampled-head-normalizer candidates are closed. Measure whether a joint-training cold-start problem actually appears before designing further methods. Native training and warmup already have prior work.
